# Finmatrix (https://finmatrix.cloud)

> Finmatrix provides free, accurate, 100% client-side personal finance and investment calculation engines paired with AI-driven financial insights. No registration or login required.

## Core Financial Calculators

- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://finmatrix.cloud/calculators/compound-interest-calculator.html): Simulate future investment wealth, monthly deposit compounding, APY vs APR yields, and doubling time horizons.
- [Paycheck Take-Home Pay Calculator](https://finmatrix.cloud/calculators/paycheck-calculator.html): Accurate 2025/2026 US Federal, FICA ($176,100 wage cap), State income tax, 401(k), and pre-tax HSA withholding models.
- [Debt Snowball vs Avalanche Calculator](https://finmatrix.cloud/calculators/debt-elimination-planner.html): Side-by-side comparison of Debt Avalanche vs Debt Snowball strategies with 0% APR balance transfer math.
- [Time Value of Money (TVM) Calculator](https://finmatrix.cloud/calculators/time-value-of-money-calculator.html): Calculate Future Value (FV), Present Value (PV), and purchasing power inflation decay.
- [Mortgage Payment Calculator](https://finmatrix.cloud/calculators/mortgage-calculator.html): Complete PITI mortgage calculation with property taxes, PMI, homeowners insurance, and full 30-year amortization.
- [Credit Card Payoff Calculator](https://finmatrix.cloud/calculators/credit-card-payoff-calculator.html): Minimum payment trap calculations, interest savings timelines, and 0% APR transfer break-even math.
- [FIRE Early Retirement Calculator](https://finmatrix.cloud/calculators/fire-calculator.html): Calculate your 25x FIRE number, safe withdrawal rates (4% rule), savings rate %, and retirement timeline.
- [Retirement Growth Calculator](https://finmatrix.cloud/calculators/retirement-calculator.html): Nest egg growth simulations and 4% safe withdrawal monthly income projections.
- [Roth vs Traditional IRA Calculator](https://finmatrix.cloud/calculators/roth-vs-traditional-ira-calculator.html): Compare tax-free growth vs tax deduction benefits under 2025/2026 IRS contribution limits ($7,000 max).
- [Personal Loan Calculator](https://finmatrix.cloud/calculators/loan-calculator.html): Monthly payment and principal vs interest amortization schedule.
- [Emergency Fund Calculator](https://finmatrix.cloud/calculators/emergency-fund-calculator.html): 3 to 6 month essential expense cushions with HYSA yield calculations.
- [Home Affordability Calculator](https://finmatrix.cloud/calculators/home-affordability-calculator.html): 28/36 front/back-end debt-to-income underwriting ratio calculations.
- [529 College Savings Calculator](https://finmatrix.cloud/calculators/college-savings-calculator.html): Higher education tuition inflation forecasting (5%-7%) and tax-free 529 plan savings models.

## Strategy Guides & Documentation
- [Credit Card Debt Elimination Guide](https://finmatrix.cloud/articles/ultimate-credit-card-debt-elimination-guide.html): Comprehensive debt elimination strategies and balance transfer formulas.
- [HYSA vs CD Comparison](https://finmatrix.cloud/articles/hysa-vs-cd-2025.html): APY yields, liquidity rules, and inflation protection analysis.
- [Rent vs Buy Analysis](https://finmatrix.cloud/articles/rent-vs-buy-2025.html): True unrecoverable housing cost equations and down payment opportunity cost.
- [50/30/20 Budgeting Rule](https://finmatrix.cloud/articles/50-30-20-rule-budgeting.html): Mathematical budget allocation for needs, wants, and wealth accumulation.
- [The 4% Safe Withdrawal Rule](https://finmatrix.cloud/articles/what-is-the-4-percent-rule.html): Trinity Study empirical benchmarks and safe withdrawal math.
- [Debt Avalanche vs Snowball](https://finmatrix.cloud/articles/avalanche-vs-snowball-debt.html): Interest rate optimization vs behavioral momentum comparison.
- [Roth IRA vs 401(k)](https://finmatrix.cloud/articles/roth-ira-vs-401k.html): Tax bracket optimization and employer match prioritization.
- [How to Build an Emergency Fund](https://finmatrix.cloud/articles/how-to-build-emergency-fund.html): 3-6 month cash reserve targets and HYSA compounding.
- [How to Start Investing with $50](https://finmatrix.cloud/articles/investing-50-dollars.html): Fractional shares, low-cost index funds, and automated compounding.
- [Boost Credit Score in 30 Days](https://finmatrix.cloud/articles/boost-credit-score-30-days.html): Credit utilization optimization and dispute strategies.
- [7 High-Paying Side Hustles for $1,000/Mo](https://finmatrix.cloud/articles/side-hustles-1000-month.html): Monetizing high-value skills and digital assets.
